d: Iran escalates tensions in the Strait of Hormuz as three oil tankers reportedly catch fire after hitting naval mines, while another vessel faces a projectile attack. Tehran tightens shipping restrictions, raising fears of disruption to global oil trade as war-risk insurance costs soar. US President Donald Trump backs the naval blockade, seeking a lasting nuclear deal. Meanwhile, Iran, Russia and China condemn military strikes on Iranian nuclear facilities, demanding security guarantees and an end to military threats before normal IAEA inspections resume. Josh Barnes tells you more on…
